title: Coast Guard rescues missing diver near Government Cut
description: A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew vectors in a Coast Guard Station Miami 33-foot Special Purpose Craft-Law Enforcement boat crew to rescue a stranded diver near Government Cut, Florida, Apr. 20, 2020. Coast Guard Sector Miami Command Center watchstanders received a call stating a diver was stranded in the water, and launched a Station Miami Beach small boat crew and an Air Station Miami helicopter to search. (Coast Guard Video)
keywords: Air Station Miami, missing diver, Station Miami, Government Cut, Coast Guard, search and rescue
